home.subtitle: Here’s your delivery activity.
home.emptyBody: Assignments from dispatch will appear here.

current.emptyBody: You’ll see your next assignment here.

deliveries.title: My Deliveries
deliveries.emptyBody: New assignments from dispatch will appear here.

filters.label: Search and filter my deliveries
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, shipment ID or address...
filters.searchHint: Sender or recipient name, shipment ID, pickup or drop-off address, or phone number.
filters.dateHint: Dates are the booking date (UAE time). Leave either one empty for an open range.
filters.results: {count, plural, =0 {No deliveries match} one {# delivery matches} other {# deliveries match}}
filters.empty: No shipments found matching your search.
filters.emptyHint: Search covers every delivery assigned to you, active or finished.
filters.error: We couldn't search your deliveries. Please try again.

detail.senderFee: The {amount} delivery fee is paid in cash by the sender. Don’t collect it from the recipient.

pod.title: Proof of Delivery
pod.signaturePad: Signature pad. Ask the recipient to sign here.
pod.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Handed to the recipient, or left with the building reception
pod.photoHint: Take a photo of the parcel at the delivery address.
pod.codConfirm: I confirm that I collected the required COD amount ({amount}) from the recipient.
pod.moreProof: More proof (optional): signature, code or QR

qr.mismatch: This code doesn’t match this shipment.
qr.unsupported: QR camera scanning isn’t supported on this browser — enter the code shown under the shipment’s QR label instead.
qr.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied or is unavailable.

validation.photo: Take a delivery photo before completing the delivery.
validation.outcomePhoto: Take or choose a photo before confirming.
validation.codCollected: Confirm you collected the COD amount before completing the delivery.
validation.note: Add a delivery note — for example who received the parcel.

errors.statusUpdate: Could not update status — check this is a valid next step
errors.incorrectCode: Incorrect code. Check with the recipient and try again.

cancel.title: Cancel this shipment?
cancel.description: Only cancel if the parcel won’t be collected — for example, the sender cancelled or it isn’t ready. The customer and the operations team are notified.
cancel.photoHint: Show why it can’t be collected — for example the closed shop, or the parcel that isn’t ready.

return.title: Return this parcel to the sender?
return.description: The shipment is marked Returned and won’t be delivered. Take the parcel back to the sender. The customer and the operations team are notified.
return.photoHint: Take a photo of the parcel — and of the door or building if no one answered.

updateStatus.title: What’s the new status?
updateStatus.arrivedForProof: I’ve arrived — add proof of delivery

pending.label: Pending
pending.hint: Couldn’t complete it this time. Dispatch will arrange another attempt.
pending.unavailable: Available from arrival at pickup until delivery.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.hint: The parcel won’t be collected. You’ll be asked why.
cancelled.unavailable: Only before the parcel is picked up.

in_transit.label: In Transit
in_transit.hint: You have the parcel and are on your way.

returned.label: Returned
returned.hint: Take the parcel back to the sender. You’ll be asked why.
returned.unavailable: Only after the parcel is picked up.

delivered.label: Delivered
delivered.hint: Finish with proof of delivery at the address.
delivered.unavailable: Only once the parcel is on its way to the customer.
